mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact Newtonian variational factors, arbitrary-direction Hessian, frozen scalar ADM elimination, p=1 negative longitudinal stiffness counterexample, and symbolic identities underlying a globally positive p=1/2 static constitutive construction and threshold separation theorem.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Rational arithmetic and exact symbolic real functions in SymPy 1.14.0; decimals only for reporting roots.
mathematics.conventions: c=1; (-+++); action 1/(16 pi G) times ADM bracket; h_ij=(1-2Phi)delta_ij; N=1+Psi; X=|grad Psi|^2; Y=|grad P|^2; positive attractive radial g and v; d=9/5; alpha_hi=1/2; alpha_lo=1/10000000; c2=3/100.

bounds.symbolic_family: 0<alpha_lo<alpha_hi<2, d>0, Astar>0, V>0; all g>=0; bounded kernel 0<=v<V; directional cosines squared in [0,1]
bounds.tested_profiles: p=1/2 and p=1; exact counterexample u=X/Astar^2=3 for p=1
bounds.resource_cap: 120-second wall time, 120-second CPU time, 1 MiB output cap; no randomized scan

non_claims: No full nonlinear or finite-k dynamical health result.
No PPN, Cherenkov, cosmological growth, strong-coupling or empirical separation certification.
Symbolic identities support the separately stated analytic inequalities; a check count is not their proof.
Exact target-kernel reconstruction is spherical/aligned; no arbitrary-source AQUAL equivalence is claimed.
